[SWS_CM_00058] Mapping of Stop Offer Service in case of Signal-Based IEEE1722 ACF network binding
⌈
If instructed to stop offering a service instance which is mapped to a Provide-
dUserDefinedServiceInstance of category SIGNALBASED_IEEE1722_ACF,
then the Signal-Based IEEE1722 ACF network binding shall check:
• If this is the last communication which uses the respective socket, then this socket
shall be closed. • If there is still other communication using this socket, then the socket shall be
kept open.
⌋
